mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate being observed (at any level) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market consistently prices the low interest rate environment as bullish for equities.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the time periods.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the time periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.3% in the last quarter
failure_condition: The interaction signal (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 0.3% in the last quarter) produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5.5% and rising, it signals a weak labor market that may lead to recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE rising > 0.2% in the last month
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5% and rising > 0.2% in the last month, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which may lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.3% in the last month
failure_condition: The interaction signal (INDPRO growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 0.3% in the last month) produces positive 60-day returns in less than 60% of instances.

failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.
